text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Flash-san. Today's your birthday... 
right?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is correct, but... is there 
something that concerns you?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... I was just wondering if nobody 
was going to celebrate.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. You saw me glaring at my 
notebook all alone and got worried, didn't 
you?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, though. I was just in the 
middle of quickly reshuffling my schedule 
for that very celebration.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san decorated the entire room, so 
we also have to factor in cleaning it all 
up...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? I'm sorry, you're such a stoic 
person that I wondered if maybe... That 
was rude of me...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Would you like to come have some cake 
too? Please enjoy a slice as thanks for 
your kind thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Then I shall write it in my notebook. 
Scarlet-san... Your name, that is.
